purpose: City-specific official registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review.
assessment: Official city sources confirm a local municipal Catastro department and a cadastral consultation route, but that lookup is login-gated. The public IMIP geovisor does not establish an anonymous parcel-vector layer. No polygon response or absence was inferred.
registryAssessment: The official Ayuntamiento de Mexicali identifies the Dirección de Administración Urbana as responsible for municipal cadastral authority and lists its Departamento de Catastro. The official municipal cadastral consultation URL redirects to a username/password login. The city’s open IMIP geovisor presents planning/territorial layers but no parcel feature schema was found; no feature geometry was requested.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal page identifies the Dirección de Administración Urbana’s cadastral jurisdiction and its Departamento de Catastro.
Official municipal Catastro consultation route redirects to a username/password login form; no credentials were entered and no parcel query was made.
Official city Predial page explains that account lookup uses a cadastral key; it is an account/payment service, not evidence of a public polygon layer.
Official IMIP Geovisor describes public urban-planning and territorial geospatial information; no cadastral parcel vector service was identified in the reviewed map layers.
